findings.issue: The library sets `body_proof_run` to `bool(summary['rows'])`, but it creates each row before validating source targets and continues without calling the proof stage when `_source_pair` reports errors. A blocked source precheck therefore reports `body_proof_run: true` even though no ordinary proof stage was invoked. This misstates proof provenance and prevents downstream evidence from distinguishing precheck refusal from a proof attempt.
findings.required_fix: Track whether the proof callback was actually attempted and derive `body_proof_run` from that state; preserve false when precheck prevents invocation. Add a focused test where source precheck fails and assert no callback invocation and `body_proof_run` false. Retain incomplete classification and zero credit.
